user.title: Add a star jar
user.description: One jar per child. The name prefixes every entity, so "Robin" gives sensor.robin_star_jar.

abort.already_configured: A star jar with this name already exists.

data_description.jar_size: Applies at the next award. Lowering it below the current count earns one or more rewards on that award.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty for plain messages only.
data_description.instructions: The voice the model writes in. It is asked for words only, never a number.

award.name: Award stars
award.description: Grant stars to the jar. A full jar becomes one reward, carrying overflow.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What earned them. Shown to the child and kept in the ledger.

source.name: Source
source.description: Which detector or person awarded them, e.g. chore, bedtime, parent.

adjust.name: Adjust stars
adjust.description: Reconcile the jar by a signed number of stars. Negative never drops below zero and never takes back a reward.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why the count is being corrected.

redeem.name: Redeem a reward
redeem.description: Spend one reward. Fails when none is available.
